approach.eyebrow: How I think about the work
approach.paragraphOne: I turn goals and business requirements into complete applications, connecting responsive interfaces with backend services, APIs, authentication, and data.
approach.paragraphTwo: I also deploy and connect applications in the cloud, and build custom MCP servers that let AI assistants work with external tools and services.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.description: A little more about my work, the technologies I use, and how we can get started.

expertise.question: What can you build as a full-stack developer?
expertise.answer: I build responsive React and Next.js interfaces, backend services and REST APIs, authentication flows, and MongoDB or PostgreSQL data integrations.

technology.question: Which technologies do you work with?
technology.answer: My core tools include React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL. I also work with REST APIs, Vercel deployments, and MCP integrations.

projects.question: What kinds of projects have you built?
projects.answer: My work includes full-stack web platforms, Google Calendar MCP for AI-assisted calendar workflows, and a local file-system MCP integration for controlled file and folder operations.

services.question: What can you help build?
services.answer: I help with full-stack web applications, backend and REST API development, cloud deployment and application integration, and custom AI and MCP integrations.

collaboration.question: How do you approach a collaboration?
collaboration.answer: I start by understanding the users, workflow, and constraints, then agree on a useful first scope. I build connected pieces, review the result, and refine it based on feedback.

contact.question: How can I discuss a project with you?
contact.answer: Use the contact page to reach me through the listed contact options or schedule a conversation. Sharing the problem, intended users, and any constraints is a helpful place to start.
